Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE V OF 1995

PEOPLES MEDICAL COLLEGE AND HOSPITAL NAWABSHAH
ORDINANCE, 1995
CHAPTER I
PRELIMINARY
1. Short title and commencement.‑‑(I) This Ordinance may
be called the People's Medical College and Hospital Nawabshah Ordinance, 1995
(2) It shall come into force at once.

Establishment of the medical college

CHAPTER II
ESTABLISHMENT OF THE MEDICAL COLLEGE
3. Establishment of the Medical College.‑‑(1) A Medical
College to be called the People's Medical College and Hospital, Nawabshah shall
be established by reconstituting and reorganizing the existing Medical College
and Hospital.
(2) The People's Medical College and Hospital as
reconstituted in accordance with the provisions of this Act shall be a body
corporate having perpetual succession and common seal with power to acquire,
hold and dispose of property, both movable and immovable, and shall by the name
specified in subsection (1) sue and be sued
(3) The headquarters of the
Medical college shall be at Nawabshah.

4. Administration of the affairs of the Medical College.‑‑The general
direction and administration of the Medical College and its affairs shall vest
in a Board to be called the Board of Governors which may exercise all powers
and do all acts and things as may be necessary for the promotion and fulfilment
of the objectives of the Medical College.

(2) The Board may associate such other experts as it

(3) The members other than ex officio members shall,

(6) No act or proceeding of the Board shall be

Functions of Chairman and Members.‑‑(1) The Chairman and

(2) Until the Board is duly constituted, the Chairman

7. Meeting of

Provided that, until regulations are made in this
behalf, the meetings of the Board shall be convened by and held as directed by

Aims and objects

ORDINANCE V OF 1995
ORDINANCE V OF 1995
PEOPLES MEDICAL COLLEGE AND HOSPITAL NAWABSHAH

CHAPTER III
OBJECTIVES OF THE MEDICAL COLLEGE AND
POWERS OF THE BOARD
9. Aims and Objects.‑‑The objectives of the Medical
College shall be as follows:‑‑
(a) to improve teaching and medical facilities
available in the Medical College;
(b) to impart, medical educational including training
research demonstration at the under‑graduate and post‑graduate
level of the highest standard;
(c) to provide training facilities in various
discipline to the teachers, doctors, nurses and para‑medical staff of the
Medical College and similar other institutions;
(d) to introduce modern medical and management
techniques in the Medical College;
(e) to associate itself with other institutions for
better discharge of its functions and responsibilities.
(f) to provide best health
facilities to the people;
(g) to undertake such other activities as would
ensure effective and efficient operation of the Medical College.

sections.description:
Powers of the board

ORDINANCE V OF 1995
ORDINANCE V OF 1995
PEOPLES MEDICAL COLLEGE AND HOSPITAL NAWABSHAH

CHAPTER III
OBJECTIVES OF THE MEDICAL COLLEGE AND
POWERS OF THE BOARD
10. Powers of the Board.‑‑(I) Subject to
the other provisions of `this Act the Board may take such measures and exercise
such powers as may be unnecessary for carrying out the purposes of this
Ordinance.
(2) Without prejudice to the generality of; the
powers conferred by sub section (1), the Board shall‑‑
(a) exercise control over and supervise the
functioning of the Medical College;
(b) consider and approve the budget estimates, annual
reports and audited statements of accounts of the Medical College; .
(c) incur any expenditure necessary for carrying out
the purposes of this Ordinance in accordance with the approved budget;
(d) acquire, hold, control, administer and dispose of
the property and the fund of the Medical College including funds for specific
purposes;
(e) enter into and perform all such contracts as it
may consider necessary;
(f) arrange for the audit of
the accounts of the Medical College;
(g) raise funds and borrow money on such terms as may
be approved by Government;
(h) appoint Academic Council headed by the Principal
of the Medical College with such members as may be appointed by it for academic
work;
(i) have power to delegate any of its power to the
Chief Executive Director or any other officer of the Medical College; and
(j) frame regulations as are necessary for carrying
out the purposes of this Ordinance.

sections.shortTitle: Peoples Medical College and Hospital Nawabshah Ordinance 1995
sections.description:
Chief executive director-general

ORDINANCE V OF 1995
ORDINANCE V OF 1995
PEOPLES MEDICAL COLLEGE AND HOSPITAL NAWABSHAH
ORDINANCE, 1995
CHAPTER IV
ESTABLISHMENT
11. Chief
Executive Director‑General.‑‑(l) Government shall in
consultation with the Board appoint a whole time Chief Executive Director possessing
such qualifications and on such terms and conditions as it may determine.
(2) The Chief Executive Director shall be the Chief
Executive of the Medical College. ,
(3) Subject to the directions of the Chairman and in
accordance with the guidelines and policies laid down by the Board, the Chief
Executive Director shall‑‑
(i) supervise and control
administration of the Medical College;
(ii) be responsible for, and
have the authority necessary for over‑seeing and implementing in an
expeditious manner the decisions of and scheme and programmes approved by the
Board;
(iii) keep in its custody the records and seal of the
Medical College;
(iv) prepare reports of the activities of the Medical
College for the information of the Board and Government;
(v) submit budget estimates and
revised budget estimates to the Board;
(vi) incur expenditure within
the approved budget;
(vii) execute deeds and
documents on behalf of the Board;
(viii) perform such other functions and duties as may
be assigned to him by the Board or Chairman

17. Asset and liability.‑‑All funds,
properties, right and interest of whatever kind, used, enjoyed, possessed,
owned or vested in, or held in trust by or for existing Medical College and
Hospital and all liabilities, legally subsisting against the said Medical
College and Hospital shall stand transferred to the Medical College as
reconstituted under this Ordinance.

sections.shortTitle: Peoples Medical College and Hospital Nawabshah Ordinance 1995
sections.description:
Terms and conditions of service of persons transferred to the medical college

ORDINANCE V OF 1995
ORDINANCE V OF 1995
PEOPLES MEDICAL COLLEGE AND HOSPITAL NAWABSHAH
ORDINANCE, 1995
CHAPTER VI
MISCELLANEOUS
18. Terms and conditions of service of persons transferred to the Medical College.‑‑All
persons in the service of Government .serving in the existing Medical
College and Hospital in any capacity immediately before the commencement of
this Ordinance shall notwithstanding anything contained in any law or terms and
conditions of their service stand transferred for service under the Medical
College on such terms and conditions as may be determined by the Board:
Provided that such terms and conditions shall not be
less favourable than those admissible to them immediately before their
transfer:
Provided further that the persons so transferred
shall until the terms and conditions of service are determined shall be
governed by the terms and conditions as were admissible to them immediately
before such transfer.
